checks.evidence: Authenticator is disabled when the consecutive failed attempt limit is reached, steps 1-3: repeated failures lead to rate limiting and refusal of further attempts.
The tests use a configurable limit L and check refusal of authentication, but they never use 101 failures and never examine the subscriber account to confirm the authenticator is disabled.

Disabled authenticator is handled as specified, step 2: the authenticator is usable again only after the §3.2.2 procedure. The procedure is not identified as the authenticator binding procedure, so this does not match.
